summary: The proposed patch optimizes the .delete() method by fetching only the primary key fields, which should address the UnicodeDecodeError without introducing significant issues.

issues.description: Modifying the query to fetch only the primary key fields might affect the behavior of the deletion process, especially if there are custom deletion logic or signals that rely on other fields being fetched.
The added comment could be more descriptive about why fetching only the primary key fields is necessary.
